resources.string: No distributor found – Saga keeps its own power-saving connection. If you use several apps with notifications without Google, a shared distributor such as ntfy saves battery.
Own connection is off. To get notifications in the background, install a distributor such as ntfy, or turn the own connection back on.
Connected · heartbeat about every %1$d min (at most %2$d wake-ups per hour)
Not connected right now – reconnects by itself as soon as there is a network.
Your network or the server’s reverse proxy drops idle connections early, so Saga has to send heartbeats more often. Admins: see the guide, section “Reverse proxy”.
Optional: if notifications arrive late on your phone (some manufacturers stop background apps), you can exempt Saga from battery optimization. Stock Android doesn’t need this.
Shown while Saga keeps its own connection for notifications (no distributor installed). You can hide this notification.
Saga is waiting for notifications – power-saving, without Google.
